records.note: The EIA-860M table for August 2026, Operating sheet, lists generator 311 at the Fisk Street plant (plant code 886) in Cook County, Illinois. It is a 32.5 MW nameplate gas turbine burning distillate fuel oil, in service since 1968, owned by Midwest Generation. PJM's letters call the unit it belongs to CT31, which is made of two generators. GEM has only the retired coal units at this site, so this oil peaker is missing. Midwest Generation told PJM on February 3, 2025 that it withdrew its earlier retirement notice, and again on July 2, 2026 that it agreed to PJM's request to keep the units running until May 31, 2031. No planned retirement year is proposed, because that date is a reliability extension and not a retirement notice. The owner's figures to PJM, such as 49.1 MW for Fisk CT31, cover both generators of the unit together and look like net capacity, so they are lower than the EIA nameplate total of 65 MW.
